opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – UK
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. Applications are welcomed from any field, including arts and culture, humanities and social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.
opportunities.summary: Seed‑funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together, covering festivals, exchanges, collaborative outputs, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record, but practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields are also welcome. Proposals must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be supported by referees not based at the same institution as either partner.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference, and publication costs.
